text:
maria: FYI customer (AcmeCorp) opened a high-priority ticket - hosted API returning 502/504s on inference calls since ~09:12 UTC after the autoscale event. They see failures mostly on long streaming sessions.

alex: Thanks — any trace ids or sample req/res? Also which region?

maria: eu-west-1. Sample trace id: trace-09a1b2c3. Quick curl they used:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"model":"gpt-open-3b","prompt":"...","stream":true}'
```
They reported intermittent 502 with upstream reset and occasional 504s.

jordan: Reproduced locally with a small burst of streams (50 concurrent), saw conn window resets on the edge. Envoy logs show: `upstream reset: connection failure` and a bunch of `H2_STREAM_RESET` entries.

alex: Sounds like keepalive/connwindow pressure. Did the deploy change envoy config or proxy pools?

maria: There was a routing tweak in frontdoor for sticky routing roll-forward at 09:01, small config to prefer warm pools.

eng-sre-bot: Deploy detected: frontdoor/stable -> frontdoor/v2 @ 2025-02-10T09:01:02Z (change-id: fd-7023). Autoscale event at 09:10:15Z.

sam: Observed ERA metrics: edge h2 active streams spiked to 14k, upstream conn windows hit 100% on several hosts, auth-cache miss rate increased during the spike.

alex: Two hypotheses: (1) routing change caused uneven fanout to a subset of midproxy hosts causing connwindow exhaustion; (2) auth cache misses triggered extra backend chattiness, amplifying connections and evicting keepalives.

support-lead: Mitigation for customer right now? They want a fast workaround.

jordan: Short term: throttle client concurrency per-tenant at edge (reduce outstanding streams), and roll back the routing tweak if we see imbalance. Also enable 1m extra keepalive for the midproxy pool.

maria: Pushing temporary route rollback now. Notifying AcmeCorp to reduce client parallelism to 10.

eng-sre-bot: Route rollback started: frontdoor/v2 -> frontdoor/stable (change-id: fd-7023-roll).

alex: Also enabling detailed envoy admin snapshot on the affected hosts and increasing h2 window to test if that relieves resets. Will collect `server.stats` and `server.connections` snapshots.

maria: Customer confirmed errors dropped after we asked them to throttle and after rollback. Still collecting logs to verify clean recovery.

jordan: Repro steps for postmortem:
1) Run 5k streaming reqs with tenant-id header set to sample tenant (simulate 80% long streams).
2) Apply routing tweak that biases 20% of traffic to subset of midproxy hosts.
3) Observe connwindow / keepalive saturation and envoy H2 resets.

alex: Data to gather: envoy admin /stats, midproxy keepalive pool sizes, auth cache hit/miss timelines, trace ids for failed requests, kernel-level TCP drops.

sam: I grabbed a diagnostics bundle from eu-west-1 host-22: `/var/log/envoy/admin-20250210.tgz` (S3 link: internal only). It shows many `last_stream_id` gaps and `RST_STREAM` codes 2 and 11.

support-lead: Next steps: full rollback confirmed, customer notified, schedule a postmortem with eng-runtime + eng-sre + product to discuss longer-term fixes (tenant-aware backpressure, auth-cache warming, and improved routing fairness).

maria: Will open a support ticket update and attach traces + diag bundle. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
